newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Silvermines says 27 pct open offer taken up.
newsitem.headline: Silvermines says 27 pct open offer taken up.

text.p: Silvermines Group Plc said on Monday that valid applications had been received in respect of 4.5 million new ordinary shares, representing 27.05 percent of an open offer announced in October.
Silvermines said in a statement that the balance would be taken up by institutional and other investors after the placing which will be done by Greig Middleton & Co and Riada Corporate Finance.
Dealings are expected to commence in the new shares on November 5, it said.
